status: Frozen before new baseline evaluation; retrospective extension of an already explored study, not a new confirmatory holdout.
reuse: Identical cached evaluation features and base/aware ETA models; same three rolling windows, K=3/5, historical actual stages only in calibration, software-plan proxy in evaluation.
budget: Exactly one query per route; same task eligibility and deterministic tie break as original.

methods.expected_change: sum_s p(s|x)*abs(f1(x,s)-f0(x)); sensitivity heuristic, not expected loss reduction.
methods.generative_voi: sum_s p(s|x)*E_e[abs(f0-f1(x,s)-e)-abs(e)], where e=y-f1(x,s) is the empirical stage-conditional calibration residual distribution. Integrals exact using sorted residuals. Model-based one-step expected utility adaptation, not an exact reproduction of a published neural architecture.
methods.conditional_risk: Fit calibration absolute baseline and informed losses on available x plus observed historical stage. Enumerate all stages and integrate predicted loss difference under the same frozen p(s|x).
methods.separate_risk: Fit two calibration risk regressors on available x: baseline loss and observed informed loss; subtract predictions. One-step risk regression control, identical learner parameters and route weights as direct gain.
methods.error_only: Use predicted baseline absolute loss to query the most error-prone task. Separates high error from high information value.

parameters: All additional risk models use original selector parameters: 200 trees, lr .04,15 leaves,min child100,lambda10,seed20260913; no evaluation tuning. Negative predicted risks clipped at zero, then differences computed.
statistics: Route-equal MAE; paired 2000 driver-cluster bootstrap, same seed; report all windows and methods. Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals over 2 stage variants x 5 new primary comparisons alongside ordinary intervals.
stress: clean,independent refusal25/50,entropy-linked refusal25/50,adjacent error10/20,uniform other-stage error10/20. Exact expectations; no evaluation-noise fitting.
limits: Comparisons are transparent adaptations to fixed-feature cross-instance regression acquisition, not complete reproductions of general sequential AFA systems; no human responses or economic cost observations.
